title: Cloud Security: workload rates
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for workload rates.

## Basis

Primary unit rate: Standard primary usage rate in USD per primary quantity unit before region factors; decimal.

Reference protected workload count: Reference protected workload count; integer.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Primary unit rate | Reference protected workload count |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 0.024 | 50 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 0.023 | 100 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 0.022 | 250 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 0.021 | 500 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 0.02 | 1000 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 0.019 | 2500 |

## Tier comparison

For primary unit rate, the 50 Workloads tier lists 0.024 and the 2500 Workloads tier lists 0.019.
